name: Equifax Breach (with Mitigations/Detections)
desc: Attack flow on the 2017 Equifax breach.

acts.d: US-CERT warned about a vulnerability within Apache Struts. Attackers searched the web for systems with this vulnerability
Attackers used software designed to exploit the Apache Struts Web Framework vulnerability to gain access to Equifax's online dispute portal
New attackers exploited foothold and installed web shell onto the Online Dispute Portal
Attackers conducted recon on the online dispute portal to obtain valid credentials for database servers
Attackers conducted recon to identify databases with PII
Queried databases for PII using existing encrypted channels
Split and compress output files with information
Obfuscate PII information to evade DLP systems

acts.n: Exfiltration Over Asymmetric Encrypted Non-C2 Protocol
acts.d: Exfiltration over standard encrypted web protocols to disguise the exchanges as normal network traffic
Attackers used multi-hop proxies in approximately thirty-four servers located in nearly twenty countries
Deleted the compressed files after exfiltrating the sensitive data
Wiped log files on a daily basis in an effort to eliminate records of activity
